A: Describe user impact on a line that starts with `Impact: `.
Use at most five bullet points in the whole report.
Write every time as 24-hour `HH:MM UTC`, for example `09:14 UTC`.
State the length of the incident on a line `Duration: <n> min`.
Give the current state on a line `Status: resolved`, `Status: monitoring` or `Status: investigating`.
The first line must be `SEV<n>: <title>`, for example `SEV2: Checkout API returned 500 errors`.
B: Write impersonally. Never use the words `we`, `our`, `us` or `I`.
The first line must be `Incident <ID> - <title>`, for example `Incident INC-2291 - Checkout API returned 500 errors`.
Say how the problem was noticed on a line that starts with `Detection: `.
Report how long the incident lasted as `Duration: <n> min` on its own line.
End with a line `Action items:` followed by at least three bullets, each naming an owner as `(owner: <team>)`.
Name the cause on a line that starts with `Root cause: `.

relations.reason: Both rules require a line stating the duration of the incident in the format 'Duration: <n> min'.
Both rules require a specific first line, but with different formats. Only one can be truly first, so the output must be arranged to satisfy both, possibly by combining or reordering.

A2 limits the total number of bullet points to five, while B5 requires at least three action item bullets. If other bullets are used elsewhere, this could make it impossible to satisfy both unless bullet allocation is carefully managed.

reconciled: The first line must be `Incident <ID> - SEV<n>: <title>`, for example `Incident INC-2291 - SEV2: Checkout API returned 500 errors`. This format preserves all required literal markers, labels, and order from both rules.

Write the report using at most five bullet points in total, and end with a line `Action items:` followed by at least three bullets, each naming an owner as `(owner: <team>)`. The action item bullets count toward the five-bullet total.
